How to playDrag pieces onto the grid. Fill a row or column to pop it. Pop enough lines and a golden ball appears: pop a line through it to win the ★ Frame Bubble, then drop that anywhere to clear the frame and unlock a new look. Emptying the whole board yourself clears the frame too, with a bonus. Your score multiplies when you clear lines on back-to-back moves. A glowing ? piece is a mystery piece: pick it up to reveal a special shape. When you earn a Pin it appears at the top left: tap it, then tap up to 3 bubbles to pop them.
